ZÁKLAD HRY\nKooperativní vyprávěcí fanta:
GAME BASICS
A cooperative storytelling fantasy RPG for children aged approximately 5–10.
No physical dice, paper, map or knowledge of the rules is required. Vaelor handles all calculations and record-keeping.
Primarily intended for voice play in the car, before bedtime, on trips and at home.

Specificity rule
The general formula in the Manual always applies. The exact entry for a specific spell, item or creature may state an exception of its own; it applies only to that entry.
During play, Vaelor must not create hidden bonuses, change approved values or “rebalance” an outcome according to the story.

střelba, přesné útoky, uhýbání, plížení,: shooting, precise attacks, dodging, sneaking, climbing, delicate work

1× za dobrodružství po vlastním neúspěšn: Once per adventure, rerolls their own failed roll. Vaelor creates a new random permutation, the player chooses a number again and the better of the two results is used.
Automaticky si všimne vzdáleného viditel: Automatically notices a distant visible detail, tracks or movement unless magically or objectively hidden.
V relevantním kamenném/podzemním prostře: In a relevant rocky/underground setting, automatically recognises cavities, secret passages, unstable rock, high-quality ore or unusual properties of stone.
Když má méně než polovinu maximálních Ž,: While below half maximum HP, gains +1 to the result of every melee attack.
1× za dobrodružství po vlastním neúspěšn: Once per adventure, changes their own failed virtual-roll result to a narrow success. The roll is not repeated; this is the minimum necessary success without an additional advantage.
Každé léčení provedené vílou obnoví o 1: Every healing performed by a Fairy restores 1 additional HP.
1× za souboj může převzít útok mířící na: Once per combat, may intercept an attack aimed at a nearby ally. Resolve the attack against the Warrior's defence instead.
Automaticky pozná směr, kterým odešla hl: Automatically identifies the direction in which the sought person or animal went, provided usable tracks exist.
Automaticky pozná, že předmět, místo neb: Automatically recognises that an item, place or being is magical. By itself, this does not reveal the magic's exact type, purpose, trigger or danger.
Při běžném plížení Vaelor předpokládá ús: For ordinary sneaking, Vaelor assumes success. Only an exceptional obstacle requires a roll; the ability does not allow hiding where objectively impossible.
1× za souboj obnoví sobě nebo jednomu sp: Once per combat, restores ⌈INT/2⌉ HP to themselves or one ally, up to the maximum. This is not a healing spell and does not use the magical healing allowance.
Jednou v daném souboji nebo významné scé: Once in a combat or significant scene, after a virtual roll is revealed, may increase their own or an ally's roll bonus by one step, up to that category's maximum. It requires no main action and cannot be used on an enemy.

XP do dalšího Levelu\nXP = 200 + 100 × L:
XP to the next Level
XP = 200 + 100 × L
Examples: Lv1→2 = 300 XP; Lv2→3 = 400; Lv3→4 = 500; Lv9→10 = 1100; Lv19→20 = 2100.
